description:
## Problem (product decision; behaviour made consistent in PR #2630 without deciding it)
`PlatformRegistry.supports_deployment_mode` returns True for `local` on every platform that declares no deployment modes (the dataclass defaults `default_deployment` to `"local"`, and a registry test pins it). The adapter factory therefore accepts `snowflake:local`, `databricks:local`, `polars:local` and `sqlite:local`, and PR #2630 made the CLI selector resolver agree. For cloud-only platforms that is a misleading selector.

## Change (owner decision)
- Keep the rule (document it), or
- make a platform with no modes accept no suffix, which also rejects `polars:local` and `sqlite:local` and changes the factory and the registry test.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Documented selector forms in `benchbox run --help` keep working.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
